G5.basis_en: R remains absent; urgency is not mistaken for a numeric resource constraint.

G6.basis_en: No ontology binding is asserted and no authority is inferred from ADMIN, ME, or child agents.

G7.basis_en: FormalCoverageGap and invented_constraints are empty and all stated prohibitions are retained.
